qrt.text:
Mercury 3 is live: the most capable diffusion LLM released to date.

It outperforms GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 across a range of benchmarks while running at over 1,000 tokens per second.

More than 40x the size of Mercury 1, 3x more intelligent across standard benchmarks, and just as fast, with a 1M-token context window.

Available today on the Inception API, @baseten, and @OpenRouter .

text:
Note that this is not our Intelligence Index. The announcement also referred to scores for AA-Omniscience and GDPval-AA v2, which do not follow our methodology and are not comparable to scores on Artificial Analysis. 

AA-Omniscience uses a private dataset (though we open sourced a public subset of 10%) and GDPval-AA v2 needs to use our grading methodology and our model comparison set to be comparable.
